book.name: Luka
book.title: Lijambu la Amboni ngati ejuandiki Luka

content: Yesu jaatuma banafunzi baki komi na abeli
Yesu jaakema pamu banafunzi baki komi na abeli, jaapekia makili nu uwesu gwakaboa bandu ilombu, nakwalamisa agonzu.
Ndienu jaatuma ajenda bakaalandila bandu lijambu lu Ukolongu waka Sapanga nakalamisa agonzu.
Jaapwagila, “Mwiitoto sindu sokapi emwijenda mwiindela, mwitoto ndonga, wala kibwahila, wala posu, wala lupija, wala ingobu ibeli.
Nyumba jokapi jemwijingala nukunzopa, mwakatama momu mbaka pamwiboka mwikijiji se hesi.
Bandu nabunkaniki kunzopa, mmbokaniya musi we hogu, nanamu emwibia ntenda kuboka mwikung'unda luhombi mwamagolu ginu jibiya nginyuli kwabu jukunkana kunzowane.”
Ndipala, banafunzi batenda kuboka, bapeta kila hijiji koni bakaalandila bandu Lijambu la Amboni nakalamisa agonzu kila pandu.
Lujogopu lwaka nkolongu Helode
Nkolongu Helodi juku Galilaya, pajabona majambu goha gagahengika. Jajogupa ndaba bandu bangi babiya apwaaga, Yohana mmbatisa juyokiki.
Bandu bangi bapwaga Elia jutei kupitii, na bangi bapwaga jombi ndi jumu ja alota baka Sapanga ba mwandi, jutei kuyoka.
Helodi japwaaga, “Yohana mmbatisa we nunsekwii kimutu, jo nyowana majambu gake hoju nyane?” Najombi japala ammbona.
Yesu jaapeke posu bandu bingi
Atumi bala pabakelubuka bumpwagila Yesu goha gabahengiki. Yesu jaajukua banafunzi baki nukujenda nabu pandu panga na bandu kumusi uku Betisaida.
Lakini bandu ebamanya kobapiti, batenda kunkagu. Yesu jaajopa, na kwaabola Ukolongu waka Sapanga egubii nakalamisa boka babapala kulama.

Palajingala lyoba, banafunzi komi na abeli bala bunzendila Yesu nukumpwagi, “Waapwagila bandu haba ajendaninnya kwijiji ya pambipi na kwamatui bakataputa posu na pandu pukugone, ndaba pamba je pulungwenza.”
Lakini Yesu jaapwagila, “Mwaapekia mwanganya poso akulaje.” Nabombi bunzibua, “Twepani tubii na mabumunda unhwano na homba ibele pena. Boo gupala lee tujenda twabeti twakaalombila posu bandu behaba?”
Papuje babii akanalomi ngati elupu unhwano. Yesu jaapwagila banafunzi baki, “Mwapwagila bandu beaba atama malundumalundu ga bandu makomi nhwanu.”
Banafunzi baki batenda ngati ejaapwagila, na bandu boti batama pai.
Ndipala Yesu jajukua mabumunda unhwanu na homba ibeli yela, jalingalya kunani kwaka Sapanga kwaka Sapanga, nukuipengee. Ndienu janukula mabumunda nahomba, nakaapeke banafunzi baki baabagila bandu.
Bandu boha bakula, nukutupi. Na banafunzi baki batondwi makombu gagaigali itonga yeyatweli komi ni ibeli.
Petili jujetake kuundomu waki Yesu ndi Kilisitu nkombosi
Lisoba limu Yesu jabiya kajika jaki andoba Sapanga. Banafunzi baki babi bunzendila pajubii, najombi jaalalukiya, “Boo bandu apwaga ne nanyane?”
Nabombi bapwaga, “Bandu bangi apwaga we wa Yohana Mmbatisa, bangi apwaga we wa Elia na bangi apwaga jumu kati ja Alota baka Sapanga ba mwandi jojuyokiki.”
Najombi jalalukiya, “Mwanganya boo, mpwaga ne nanyane?” Petili japwaga, “Weapa ndi Kilisitu weguhumiki kwaka Sapanga.”
Yesu julongale kuwa kwaki
Ndipala Yesu jaakanakiya mwampwagi mundu jokapi lijambu le hele.
Ahelahe Yesu jaapwagila, “Mwana waka Mundu jupalika kung'alika ngamaa nu kunkana aseja na agolu akolongu na abola ba Malagalaki. Jwiitenda kukomeka lakini jwiyoka mlisoba la tatu.”
Ndipala Yesu jaapwagila bandu boha, “Mundu jokapi najupai kunyengale ne, kupalika julikana na majambu gaki mweni nukujuku nsalaba waki, junyengaliya.
Mundu jokapi jojupala kugugombo womi waki mweni, jitenda kuguhoa, lakini mundu jojuhoa womi waki ndaba jami ne jaguokuwa womi waki wamasoba goha.
Boo sanzangatiya kii mundu ana jupatiki kila sindu su punndema pane koni na julihoa mweni?
Mundu jojumonee nepani iyoni pamu na mabolee gangu, Mwana waka Mundu jaambonila iyoni mundu we hoju pajihika mu ulumbi waki nu ulumbi wa Ahengo nu ulumbi wa atumisi ba asapi bu kunani kwaka Sapanga.
Numpwagi sakaka, abii bangi apamba ngabikuwi mbaka pabagubona Ukolongu waka Sapanga.”
Yesu jung'anambuka kubonikana waki
Egapeta masoba nani tumbuka ejapwaga majambu ge gala, Yesu anzukua Petili na Yakobu na Yohana bakwela pikitombi kundoba Sapanga.
Yesu pababiya jakaloba, bumbona jakang'anumbuka pamihu, ni ingobu yaki yabia iyuu kwejakweja.
Apalapa bandu abeli babia alonge naku. Bandu be haba babia Musa na Elia,
babonikana abi muulumbi gukunani kwaka Sapanga kwaka Sapanga na bakalongila na Yesu lijambu la kuwa kwaki kokwipitila ku Yelusalemu.
Petili na ajaki babi agosi lugonu, na pabajumuka bugubona ulumbi waka Yesu, baabona na bandu abeli bajabi jujemiki nabu pamwa.

Musa na Elia pababia bakaboka, Petili ampwagila Yesu, “Bambu, sapi twe kutama pambane. Tusenga indamba hitatu, simwa sako, simwa saka Musa na sengi saka Elia.” Lakini Petili ngasejamanyiki sejikipwaga.
Petili ejwabiya jakalongila, gapitila mahundi nakaayekale, na banafunzi bajogapa ngamaa liundi elaayekaliya.
Sauti japita kuhuma mulihundi, “Jonzo ndi Mwanangu jonuwagwi, munzowaniya.”
Sauti ejatumbala, Yesu jabonikana jubii kajika jaki. Banafunzi batumbala kinunu na ngasebumpwagi mundu jokapi sindu sebikibweni masoba ge gala.
Yesu andamisa nkombu jwini ilombu
Elwahika lukela Yesu na banafunzi baki atatu bahuluka kuhuma kukitombi, nu nsambi wa bandu jatenda kuketangana nabu.
Mundu jumwa mu nsambi we gola jajamalia kwa sauti, japwaga, “Mmbola! Nuguloba gundingaliya mwanango, ndaba jonioju mwanawa wakajika!
Kilombu kikuba kitenda kuntukali nukunhenga jujamalia, sunzege kihindu hindu, ni lihuluhulu lumpita kukanu nukuendale kunng'alisa na ngase sundekakeye kanyata!
Naalobalakiya banafunzi baku bikiboha kilombu, lakini ngasebawesike.”
Yesu japwaga, “Mmbanganya mwabandu bikibeleku sanga kuhobale na sekihobiki! Boo ndama na mwanganya nukunhinakali mbaka lile?” Ndipala ampwagila mundu we jola, “Gunndeta mwanawaku we pamba.”
Nkombu we jola ejwabiya anzende Yesu, kilombu se sela suhabua pai nukunzege kihindu hindu. Lakini Yesu jikilakaliya kilombu, nukundamisa nkombu we jola nukunkelabu kwa ahengo baki.

Bandu boka basangia ku uwesu nkolongu waka Sapanga. Yesu julongale kabee kuwa kwaki Matei 17:22-23; Maluko 9:30-32 Bandu ebabiya bakona bakasangia majambu goha gajutei Yesu, jaapwajila banafunzi baki,
“Nnzowaniya sapi malobi ganga gambala kumpwaji! Mwana waka Mundu jupalika kunkabisa mwamaboku ga bandu.”
Lakini banafunzi baki ngasebamanyiki ndaba lilobi heli, ndaba lijambu leheli babibia baahihiki kwabu ili biimanya, nabombi bajogipi kundaluki Yesu ndaba ja malobi haga.
Nya jojubi nkolongu?
Banafunzi baka Yesu batumbuliya kubisana nya jojubii nkolongu kati jabu.
Lakini Yesu jamanyiki kuholale kwabu, ndipala anzukua mwana nsoku nukumbeka pambipi jaki,

ndipala jaapwajila banafunzi baki, “Mundu jokapi joanzopa mwana nsoku ngati jonzo kulihina langu, junyopa nenga. Na mundu jokapi jojinyopa nepani, ahelahe anzopa jojundumiki nepani. Ndaba mundu jokapi jojubii nsoku kati jinu jibia nkolongu kupeta boti.”
Jwanga kupengana na numbanganya jubi upandi wino
Yohana jajangila kupwaga, “Bambu, tumbweni mundu jumu jakaapia ilombu kulihina lako natwe tunkana ndaba jombi nga jumu wito.”
Lakini Yesu ampwagila Yohana na banafunzi bangi, “Mwankana, ndaba mundu jokapi jwanga kupengana na mwanganya jubii pamu na twee.”
Bandu bikijiji sa Samalia akana kunzopa Yesu
Masoba gaka Yesu gukujukulika kujenda kunani kwa mahundi kwaka Sapanga pagaeliya, Yesu japala kujenda ku Yelusalemu.
Jaatuma atumi bundonguliya na ajenda mwiijiji yuku Samalia ili bukuhandaliya kila sindu.
Lakini bandu buku Samalia ngase bunzopike, ndaba bamanyiki jujenda ku Yelusalemu.
Banafunzi baki, aka Yakobu na Yohana ebagabona haga, bundalukiya Yesu, “Bambu, boo gupala tundoba Sapanga juhuluwa mwotu kuhuma kunani kwaka Sapanga gwatiniya tikitiki ngati ejatei Elia?”
Yesu jang'alumbukiya nakalakali.
Ndipala Yesu na banafunzi baki bajenda mwikijiji sengi.
Majambu gagapaliki kumpwata Yesu
Pababi mwiindela, mundu jumwa ampwagila Yesu, “Nagupwata kwokapi kola kowijenda.”
Yesu jaapwagila, “Mabwea gabi ni imbaku yabu ni ijuni ibi ni ihui yabu, lakini Mwana waka Mundu ngasejubi na pandu pukupomulela wala pukubeka kimutu saki.”
Yesu ampwagila mundu jongi, “Bwata.” Lakini mundu jola japwaga, “Bambu gunendaliya hoti muja ku nyumba nakaataga atati bango.”
Yesu ampwagila, “Waaleka baawii haba baataga ajabu, ila we gujenda ukalandila bandu lijambu lu Ukolongu waka Sapanga.”
Mundu jongi kabee ampwagila, “Bambu nagujengaliya lakini lendaliya hoti nakaatabuka alongu bango.”
Yesu ampwagila, “Mundu jokapi jojutumbuka kulema koni jakalinga munyuma ngasejuwesa kujangati sokapi mu Ukolongu waka Sapanga.”
